reviews.author: Jooah Lee
reviews.text:
👽One thing that so-called popular fashion brands have in common is that they set up their stores like exhibitions. The branding effect is so great that they are willing to give up an entire floor of their store to an exhibition-like display showing their colors!

Among them, Hongdae's Other Error, which is said to be popular not only domestically but also overseas, was good for its moderately industrial yet witty sensibility. The first floor is operated as an exhibition hall, and the second floor is operated as a store.
The staff were reasonably friendly and it was really nice to see the fabric of the clothes in person. Does this feel like a demonstration of ‘this is how a fashion store space should be’?
I heard there is a long line to get into the new Seongsu-dong store these days... I have to go there quickly too!👽💙

reviews.author: Lynn K.
reviews.text:
It is the most meaningful place in Hongdae. As I was passing by, I was curious about the identity of the blue ball and went to see if it was on display.
I saw it. It is a fashion flagship store!
The quality of the store was so good that they used pine bark on the floor, which made me feel like I was in the forest and the scent was really nice. The clothes themselves are attractive in design and have a simplicity that is comfortable for the general public.
It seems like a lot of people from the fashion world are coming. There are many foreigners as well. It was refreshing in Hongdae, which is always the same.
It's a good place to take pictures. The objects placed here and there are impressive.

reviews.author: s s (Louis)
reviews.text:
It’s a bookstore that’s like my own hideout that I definitely want to stop by when I come to Hongdae.
Magazine Land is a place where various magazines and design books from around the world are gathered in one place.
You can find independent magazines and art books that are difficult to find in other bookstores.
As I turn the pages, I feel like a new world is opening up.

The atmosphere of the space itself is really attractive.
The lighting, the colors of the books, and even the fully stocked magazine shelves —
The moment I walked in, I thought, ‘This is a space of inspiration.’
Even when you take a photo, the emotion is captured as is,
It’s a place where you feel like time passes slowly.

Not only for people who like magazines
I also recommend it to anyone who wants to discover new tastes.
These are books curated by the owner himself.
Each volume contains a reason and a story,
Thanks to that, I naturally find myself interested in books about fields I’m not normally interested in.

A quiet but warm space with an analog sensibility.
Magazine Land is a place where the time of choosing a book itself is healing.
If you go to Hongdae, be sure to stop by.
Anyone who likes magazines will definitely be captivated.

reviews.text: It was really bad! It was a total lie! There was an “Instant Tax Refund” logo outside. After finishing shopping, I showed my passport to the employee, and the employee said that the tax refund machine was broken and gave me a receipt in Korean and said I could get a refund at the airport. I checked again to see if I could get a refund with this receipt, and the answer was the same. “Yes,” was the answer. However, when I arrived at Incheon Airport, the staff told me that it was an incorrect receipt and that I could not receive a refund. What a liar! I think we need to find a proper way to protest!

reviews.author: Tiffany Fernando
reviews.text: This was a really annoying employee!!! An older female employee yelled at me for eating away from the counter. There were food crumbs on the floor that I wasn't sure if they were spilled by me or by previous customers. For your information, it was my first time coming to Korea and I had no idea how to eat at a convenience store or what to use on the table! Moreover, I wanted to take a video of my first experience eating at a convenience store, but they looked at my phone and screamed that I couldn't film it. No, there are so many people filming mukbang vlogs at convenience stores! It was so outrageous!!! It's really wrong to receive guests without knowing how to treat them politely!!! They weren't friendly at all! Never go to this store.
